description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface 'GSIMRepositoy' for accessing 'GroupSavingsIndividualMonitoring' entities in the domain layer of the Fineract savings module. It provides methods to query entities based on various criteria such as acceptance status, application ID, account number, and group ID.

classes.name: GSIMRepositoy
classes.description: A repository interface for 'GroupSavingsIndividualMonitoring' entities, enabling CRUD and complex query operations through Spring Data JPA.

methods.name: findOneByIsAcceptingChild
methods.description: Retrieves a 'GroupSavingsIndividualMonitoring' entity where the 'isAcceptingChild' flag matches the provided boolean.

methods.name: findOneByIsAcceptingChildAndApplicationId
methods.description: Retrieves an entity matching the specified 'isAcceptingChild' status and 'applicationId'.

methods.name: findOneByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an entity based on its account number.

methods.name: findOneByIsAcceptingChildAndApplicationIdAndGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves an entity matching the 'isAcceptingChild' status, 'applicationId', and 'groupId'.
